title: Correctly handle InputStream.read() when it return -1 during writing …

timeline.message:
Correctly handle InputStream.read() when it return -1 during writing to the ByteBuf

Motivation:

We didnt correctly handle the case when the InputStream did reach EOF during writing to the ByteBuf and so return -1.

Modifications:

- Correctly handle EOF
- Add unit test

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/11829
timeline.author: Norman Maurer
